source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: God swore by the fig and the olive, which are well-known fruits; and by Mount Sinai, upon which God spoke directly to Moses; and by this land, secure from all fear, which is Mecca, the place where revelation descended. We created man in the best form, then We returned him to the Fire if he does not obey God and follow the messengers; but those who believed and did righteous deeds will have a great reward that is neither cut off nor diminished.

tafsir.muyassar-7: What leads you, O man, to deny the resurrection and recompense, despite the clear evidence of God Almighty's power over that?
tafsir.muyassar-8: Is not God, who made this day for judging between people, the wisest of all judges in all that He created? Yes. So would creation be left aimless, neither commanded nor forbidden, neither rewarded nor punished? That is neither right nor possible.
